cc:Work.dc:title: Qwen3.5-9B: capabilities
cc:Work.dc:description: General-capability changes for Qwen3.5-9B. Both GRPO and Dyad-GRPO are compared with the same original model on MMLU-Pro, HMMT February 2026 and LiveCodeBench v6. Connecting lines are paired comparisons, not uncertainty intervals. Three evaluation seeds.
